description: Confirms live from verify.savings.club whether a Savings Club beneficiary certificate is genuine and current, from the link its QR code opens. It gives the certificate number, the beneficiary, the club and the membership's standing. Anyone may use it, such as a dealer shown the certificate.

link.description: The link the certificate's or voucher's QR code opens.
